entries.definition_en: a machine with a screen for watching shows and news
entries.example_en: Our TV is in the living room.
entries.example_vi: Ti vi nhà mình để ở phòng khách.
entries.cloze_en: We watch the news on TV in the living room.

entries.definition_en: a piece of furniture you sleep on
entries.example_en: My cat sleeps on my bed.
entries.example_vi: Con mèo của mình ngủ trên giường mình.
entries.cloze_en: Every night, I sleep in my soft bed.

entries.definition_en: to rest on a chair or on the floor
entries.example_en: Please sit next to me.
entries.example_vi: Ngồi cạnh mình đi.
entries.cloze_en: There is a free chair next to me. Please sit here.

entries.definition_en: the thing you open to go into a room or house
entries.example_en: Please close the door. It's cold.
entries.example_vi: Đóng cửa lại giúp mình nhé, lạnh quá.
entries.cloze_en: Please open the door for the guests. They are here.

entries.definition_en: the place where you live with your family
entries.example_en: After school, I go home by bike.
entries.example_vi: Tan học, mình đạp xe về nhà.
entries.cloze_en: On Sunday, I stay at home and watch TV with my family.

entries.definition_en: to look at programs on a TV
entries.example_en: We watch TV after dinner.
entries.example_vi: Ăn tối xong cả nhà xem ti vi.
entries.cloze_en: After dinner, we sit on the sofa and watch TV together.

entries.definition_en: to move a door, box or window so it is not closed
entries.example_en: Can you open the window, please?
entries.example_vi: Bạn mở cửa sổ giúp mình nhé?
entries.cloze_en: It is hot. Can you open the window, please?

entries.definition_en: one of the parts of a house with walls and a door
entries.example_en: There are four rooms in our house.
entries.example_vi: Nhà mình có bốn phòng.
entries.cloze_en: My room is small, but it has a bed and a desk.

entries.definition_en: to make something clean with water
entries.example_en: I wash my hands before I eat.
entries.example_vi: Mình rửa tay trước khi ăn.
entries.cloze_en: Wash your hands with water before you eat.

entries.definition_en: a seat for one person, with a back
entries.example_en: There are six chairs around the table.
entries.example_vi: Quanh bàn có sáu cái ghế.
entries.cloze_en: There is a chair at my desk, and I sit on it to study.

entries.definition_en: to make something not dirty
entries.example_en: We clean the house before Tet.
entries.example_vi: Nhà mình dọn dẹp nhà cửa trước Tết.
entries.cloze_en: We clean the house before Tet, so it looks new.

entries.definition_en: to move a door or window so it is not open
entries.example_en: Close your eyes and go to sleep.
entries.example_vi: Nhắm mắt lại và ngủ đi.
entries.cloze_en: It is very cold, so please close the window.

entries.definition_en: a building where people live
entries.example_en: My grandparents have a house with a big yard.
entries.example_vi: Ông bà mình có ngôi nhà với cái sân rộng.
entries.cloze_en: My grandparents live in a big house with a garden.

entries.definition_en: to rest with your eyes closed
entries.example_en: I sleep eight hours every night.
entries.example_vi: Mỗi đêm mình ngủ tám tiếng.
entries.cloze_en: I am tired, so I go to bed and sleep for eight hours.

entries.definition_en: furniture with a flat top and legs
entries.example_en: Put the plates on the table, please.
entries.example_vi: Con bày đĩa lên bàn nhé.
entries.cloze_en: Put the bowls on the table, please. Dinner is ready.

entries.definition_en: an opening in a wall with glass, to let in light
entries.example_en: I can see the river from my window.
entries.example_vi: Từ cửa sổ phòng mình nhìn thấy dòng sông.
entries.cloze_en: I open the window to let fresh air into the room.

entries.definition_en: to make a machine or light start working
entries.example_en: Turn on the light, please. It's dark.
entries.example_vi: Bật đèn lên giúp mình với, tối quá.
entries.cloze_en: It's dark in here. Please turn on the light.

entries.definition_en: a room where you sleep
entries.example_en: I share a bedroom with my sister.
entries.example_vi: Mình ở chung phòng ngủ với chị.
entries.cloze_en: My bed is in my bedroom, and I sleep there every night.

entries.definition_en: the room where you cook food
entries.example_en: Mom is cooking in the kitchen.
entries.example_vi: Mẹ đang nấu ăn trong bếp.
entries.cloze_en: Mom cooks dinner in the kitchen.

entries.definition_en: a room where you wash your body
entries.example_en: Our bathroom is next to the kitchen.
entries.example_vi: Phòng tắm nhà mình ở cạnh bếp.
entries.cloze_en: I take a shower in the bathroom every evening.

entries.definition_en: a container with flat sides, often made of paper
entries.example_en: We keep old toys in a big box.
entries.example_vi: Nhà mình cất đồ chơi cũ trong một cái thùng to.
entries.cloze_en: We keep old toys in a big box under the bed.

entries.definition_en: a small metal thing you use to open a lock
entries.example_en: I can't find my house key.
entries.example_vi: Mình không tìm thấy chìa khóa nhà.
entries.cloze_en: I can't open the door because I can't find my key.

entries.definition_en: to move something into a place
entries.example_en: Put your shoes next to the door.
entries.example_vi: Để giày cạnh cửa nhé.
entries.cloze_en: Put your shoes next to the door before you come in.

entries.definition_en: a thing children play with
entries.example_en: My little brother has many toy cars.
entries.example_vi: Em trai mình có nhiều xe ô tô đồ chơi.
entries.cloze_en: My little brother plays with his new toy car every day.

entries.definition_en: to do something with a thing for a reason
entries.example_en: We use a fan when it is hot.
entries.example_vi: Trời nóng thì nhà mình dùng quạt.
entries.cloze_en: We use a fan when it is very hot.

entries.definition_en: a table where you read, write or work
entries.example_en: I do my homework at my desk.
entries.example_vi: Mình làm bài tập ở bàn học.
entries.cloze_en: I do my homework at my desk in my bedroom.

entries.definition_en: not closed
entries.example_en: The window is open, so the room is cool.
entries.example_vi: Cửa sổ đang mở nên phòng mát.
entries.cloze_en: The shop is open from eight in the morning to nine at night.

entries.definition_en: a long soft seat for two or three people
entries.example_en: Dad sleeps on the sofa after lunch.
entries.example_vi: Bố ngủ trên ghế sofa sau bữa trưa.
entries.cloze_en: Dad sleeps on the sofa in the living room after lunch.

entries.definition_en: to make a machine or light stop working
entries.example_en: Turn off the TV and go to bed.
entries.example_vi: Tắt ti vi rồi đi ngủ đi.
entries.cloze_en: It is late. Turn off the TV and go to bed.

entries.definition_en: one of the sides of a room or building
entries.example_en: There is a family photo on the wall.
entries.example_vi: Trên tường có một tấm ảnh gia đình.
entries.cloze_en: There is a family photo on the wall of the living room.

entries.definition_en: to take something or someone with you to a place
entries.example_en: Please bring your books to class tomorrow.
entries.example_vi: Ngày mai các em nhớ mang sách đến lớp nhé.
entries.cloze_en: Please bring your books to class tomorrow.

entries.definition_en: to clean or make tidy with a brush
entries.example_en: I brush my teeth twice a day.
entries.example_vi: Mỗi ngày mình đánh răng hai lần.
entries.cloze_en: I brush my teeth after every meal.

entries.definition_en: not dirty
entries.example_en: My room is clean and tidy now.
entries.example_vi: Phòng mình giờ sạch sẽ, gọn gàng.
entries.cloze_en: I wash my shirt, and now it is clean.

entries.definition_en: not clean
entries.example_en: Your shoes are dirty. Please wash them.
entries.example_vi: Giày con bẩn rồi, đi rửa đi.
entries.cloze_en: I play soccer in the rain, and now my shoes are dirty.

entries.definition_en: the part of a room you walk on
entries.example_en: Don't put your bag on the floor.
entries.example_vi: Đừng để cặp dưới sàn nhà.
entries.cloze_en: Don't put your bag on the floor. Put it on the chair.

entries.definition_en: something that lets you see, like a lamp or the sun
entries.example_en: The light in the kitchen is too dark.
entries.example_vi: Đèn trong bếp tối quá.
entries.cloze_en: It's dark in my room. Please turn on the light.

entries.definition_en: making very little noise
entries.example_en: Please be quiet. The baby is sleeping.
entries.example_vi: Trật tự nhé, em bé đang ngủ.
entries.cloze_en: Please be quiet. The baby is sleeping.

entries.definition_en: an object you do not name
entries.example_en: Put your things in the box.
entries.example_vi: Cất đồ của con vào hộp đi.
entries.cloze_en: What is that thing on the table? — It is a new phone.

entries.definition_en: a piece of land near a house with flowers or vegetables
entries.example_en: Grandma grows vegetables in her garden.
entries.example_vi: Bà trồng rau trong vườn nhà.
entries.cloze_en: Grandma grows vegetables and flowers in her garden.

entries.definition_en: to return to the place where you live
entries.example_en: Dad comes home at six every evening.
entries.example_vi: Tối nào bố cũng về nhà lúc sáu giờ.
entries.cloze_en: Dad works all day and will come home at six this evening.

entries.definition_en: a thing that sends water down on you so you can wash
entries.example_en: The water in the shower is very hot.
entries.example_vi: Nước ở vòi sen nóng lắm.
entries.cloze_en: I take a shower every evening to wash my body.

entries.definition_en: the place or seat you use to go to the bathroom
entries.example_en: Where is the toilet, please?
entries.example_vi: Cho hỏi nhà vệ sinh ở đâu ạ?
entries.cloze_en: There is a toilet in the bathroom next to the shower.

entries.definition_en: a machine that shows pictures and sound, or the shows on it
entries.example_en: There is a good movie on television tonight.
entries.example_vi: Tối nay trên truyền hình có phim hay.
entries.cloze_en: There is a good movie on television tonight.

entries.definition_en: the room where a family sits and talks together
entries.example_en: Our living room has a big window.
entries.example_vi: Phòng khách nhà mình có cửa sổ lớn.
entries.cloze_en: We sit on the sofa in the living room and watch TV.

entries.definition_en: a machine that moves air to make you cool
entries.example_en: In summer, the fan is on all day.
entries.example_vi: Mùa hè quạt bật suốt cả ngày.
entries.cloze_en: In summer, the fan is on all day to keep us cool.

entries.definition_en: the highest part of something
entries.example_en: The cat sits on the top of the shelf.
entries.example_vi: Con mèo ngồi trên nóc kệ.
entries.cloze_en: I climb to the top of the mountain and see the city below.

entries.definition_en: a long container you fill with water and sit in to wash
entries.example_en: My little sister plays with toys in the bath.
entries.example_vi: Em gái mình chơi đồ chơi trong bồn tắm.
entries.cloze_en: My little sister plays with toys in the warm water of her bath.

entries.definition_en: a toy that looks like a small person
entries.example_en: Mai gives her doll a new dress.
entries.example_vi: Mai mặc váy mới cho búp bê.
entries.cloze_en: Mai has a small doll with long hair and a pretty pink dress.

entries.definition_en: to let something fall
entries.example_en: Be careful! Don't drop the glass.
entries.example_vi: Cẩn thận! Đừng làm rơi cái ly.
entries.cloze_en: Be careful with the glass! If you drop it, it can break.

entries.definition_en: to make something full
entries.example_en: Fill the bottle with water, please.
entries.example_vi: Con đổ đầy nước vào chai giúp mẹ.
entries.cloze_en: There is no water in the bottle. Please fill it with water.

entries.definition_en: to wash your body under a shower
entries.example_en: I take a shower after soccer.
entries.example_vi: Đá bóng xong mình đi tắm.
entries.cloze_en: After soccer, I am very dirty, so I take a shower before dinner.

entries.definition_en: to go or put something where no one can see it
entries.example_en: My cat likes to hide under the bed.
entries.example_vi: Con mèo nhà mình thích trốn dưới gầm giường.
entries.cloze_en: We play a game. I hide under the bed, and my brother looks for me.

entries.definition_en: to have something and not give it away
entries.example_en: Keep your room clean, please.
entries.example_vi: Con giữ phòng sạch sẽ nhé.
entries.cloze_en: I keep my old toys in a box under the bed.

entries.definition_en: to move something away from you with your hands
entries.example_en: Push the door to open it.
entries.example_vi: Đẩy cửa để mở ra.
entries.cloze_en: The car doesn't start, so we push it down the street.

entries.definition_en: the left or right part of something
entries.example_en: The bathroom is on the left side.
entries.example_vi: Phòng tắm ở phía bên trái.
entries.cloze_en: In Vietnam, cars drive on the right side of the street.

entries.definition_en: the land around a house
entries.example_en: The kids play in the yard after school.
entries.example_vi: Tan học bọn trẻ chơi ngoài sân.
entries.cloze_en: Our house has a big yard with grass where the kids play soccer.

entries.definition_en: in a higher place
entries.example_en: The bedroom is above, on the second floor.
entries.example_vi: Phòng ngủ ở trên, tầng hai.
entries.cloze_en: My room is on the second floor, and my sister's room is above, on the third floor.

entries.definition_en: not sleeping
entries.example_en: I am awake at six every morning.
entries.example_vi: Sáng nào sáu giờ mình cũng đã thức.
entries.cloze_en: It is two in the morning. I can't sleep, and I am awake in bed.

entries.definition_en: in a lower place
entries.example_en: The kitchen is below, on the first floor.
entries.example_vi: Nhà bếp ở dưới, tầng một.
entries.cloze_en: We live on the third floor, and Mr. Nam lives below, on the second floor.

entries.definition_en: to make something go into pieces
entries.example_en: Be careful. You can break the plate.
entries.example_vi: Cẩn thận, con có thể làm vỡ đĩa đấy.
entries.cloze_en: Be careful with that glass! It can break if you drop it.

entries.definition_en: a tool with a handle and hairs for cleaning
entries.example_en: I need a new brush for my teeth.
entries.example_vi: Mình cần một cái bàn chải đánh răng mới.
entries.cloze_en: I need a new brush to clean my teeth every morning.

entries.definition_en: to make a room tidy and not dirty
entries.example_en: I clean the room every Saturday.
entries.example_vi: Thứ Bảy nào mình cũng dọn phòng.
entries.cloze_en: My room is very dirty, so today I clean the room with my mom.

entries.definition_en: to hold something and take it with you
entries.example_en: Can you carry this box for me?
entries.example_vi: Bạn bê cái thùng này giúp mình được không?
entries.cloze_en: This bag is very heavy. Can you help me carry it to the car?

entries.definition_en: a long, soft seat in the living room
entries.example_en: My cat sleeps on the couch all day.
entries.example_vi: Con mèo của mình ngủ trên ghế dài cả ngày.
entries.cloze_en: We sit on the couch in the living room to watch TV.

entries.definition_en: at the part that faces forward
entries.example_en: Leave your shoes at the front door.
entries.example_vi: Để giày ở cửa trước nhé.
entries.cloze_en: Please wait for me at the front door of the school, not the back door.

entries.definition_en: a loud sound you do not want
entries.example_en: The noise from the street is very loud.
entries.example_vi: Tiếng ồn ngoài đường to quá.
entries.cloze_en: There is a lot of noise from the street, so I close the window to sleep.

entries.definition_en: a machine you listen to for music and news
entries.example_en: Grandpa listens to the radio every morning.
entries.example_vi: Sáng nào ông cũng nghe đài.
entries.cloze_en: Grandpa listens to music and the news on the radio every morning.

entries.definition_en: a flat board on a wall to put things on
entries.example_en: My books are on the shelf.
entries.example_vi: Sách của mình ở trên kệ.
entries.cloze_en: My books are on the shelf above my desk.

entries.definition_en: a piece of cloth you use to dry your body
entries.example_en: Take a towel to the beach.
entries.example_vi: Mang khăn tắm theo đi biển nhé.
entries.cloze_en: After my shower, I use a big towel to get dry.

entries.definition_en: at the back
entries.example_en: Lan walks in front, and I walk behind.
entries.example_vi: Lan đi trước, mình đi phía sau.
entries.cloze_en: Lan walks in front, and her little brother walks behind.

entries.definition_en: the lowest part of something
entries.example_en: The keys are at the bottom of my bag.
entries.example_vi: Chìa khóa nằm dưới đáy cặp của mình.
entries.cloze_en: The keys are at the bottom of my bag, under all my books.

entries.definition_en: in pieces or not working
entries.example_en: Our TV is broken, so we read books.
entries.example_vi: Ti vi nhà mình bị hỏng nên cả nhà đọc sách.
entries.cloze_en: My phone is broken, so I can't call you today.

entries.definition_en: not open
entries.example_en: The shop is closed on Sunday.
entries.example_vi: Chủ nhật cửa hàng đóng cửa.
entries.cloze_en: The shop is closed on Sunday, so we can't buy food there.

entries.definition_en: to clean the plates and bowls after a meal
entries.example_en: I wash the dishes after dinner.
entries.example_vi: Ăn tối xong mình rửa bát.
entries.cloze_en: After dinner, I wash the dishes and put them on the shelf.

entries.definition_en: the place where two walls meet
entries.example_en: There is a plant in the corner of the room.
entries.example_vi: Ở góc phòng có một chậu cây.
entries.cloze_en: There is a small plant in the corner of the room, next to the window.

entries.definition_en: in the center, between two other things
entries.example_en: I sleep in the middle room.
entries.example_vi: Mình ngủ ở phòng giữa.
entries.cloze_en: Nam has one big sister and one little brother. He is the middle child.

entries.definition_en: things you throw away because you do not need them
entries.example_en: Please take out the garbage after dinner.
entries.example_vi: Ăn tối xong con đổ rác giúp mẹ nhé.
entries.cloze_en: Please take out the garbage. The bag is full and it has a bad smell.

entries.definition_en: the room where you eat meals
entries.example_en: We eat dinner together in the dining room.
entries.example_vi: Cả nhà ăn tối cùng nhau trong phòng ăn.
entries.cloze_en: We eat dinner together at the big table in the dining room.

entries.definition_en: a round, flat disc for music or data
entries.example_en: My dad has many old music CDs.
entries.example_vi: Bố mình có nhiều đĩa CD nhạc cũ.
entries.cloze_en: Dad buys a new music CD and plays the songs in his car.

entries.definition_en: a round, flat disc with a movie on it
entries.example_en: We watch a DVD on Saturday night.
entries.example_vi: Tối thứ Bảy cả nhà xem đĩa DVD.
entries.cloze_en: On Saturday night, we watch a movie on DVD at home.

entries.definition_en: the space inside the front door of a house
entries.example_en: Leave your umbrella in the hall.
entries.example_vi: Để ô ở hành lang nhé.
entries.cloze_en: Leave your wet umbrella in the hall near the front door.

entries.definition_en: a thing you hold in your hand to make or fix things
entries.example_en: My dad keeps his tools in a red box.
entries.example_vi: Bố mình cất dụng cụ trong một cái hộp đỏ.
entries.cloze_en: Dad uses a tool from his red box to open the broken door.

entries.definition_en: a pot for flowers
entries.example_en: Mom puts flowers in the vase for Tet.
entries.example_vi: Mẹ cắm hoa vào lọ đón Tết.
entries.cloze_en: Mom puts the flowers in a vase with water on the table.

entries.definition_en: to make your bed tidy after you sleep
entries.example_en: I make the bed after I get up.
entries.example_vi: Ngủ dậy là mình dọn giường.
entries.cloze_en: After I get up, I make the bed so my room looks nice.

entries.definition_en: the act of cleaning something with water
entries.example_en: The car needs a good wash.
entries.example_vi: Chiếc ô tô cần được rửa sạch.
entries.cloze_en: My car is very dirty. It needs a good wash.

entries.definition_en: a book where you keep photos
entries.example_en: Grandma shows us her old photo album.
entries.example_vi: Bà cho tụi mình xem album ảnh cũ.
entries.cloze_en: Grandma keeps old family photos in a big album.

entries.definition_en: a round open container with a handle for water
entries.example_en: Fill the bucket with water to clean the floor.
entries.example_vi: Đổ đầy nước vào xô để lau nhà.
entries.cloze_en: Fill the bucket with water and clean the floor.

entries.definition_en: a home on one floor of a big building
entries.example_en: My aunt lives in a small apartment in the city.
entries.example_vi: Dì mình sống trong một căn hộ nhỏ ở thành phố.
entries.cloze_en: My aunt lives in a small apartment in a tall building in the city.

entries.definition_en: a thing with moving parts that does work
entries.example_en: Our washing machine is very old.
entries.example_vi: Máy giặt nhà mình đã rất cũ.
entries.cloze_en: Mom puts our dirty clothes in the washing machine.

entries.definition_en: a tool with sharp teeth for cutting wood
entries.example_en: Grandpa cuts the wood with a saw.
entries.example_vi: Ông cắt gỗ bằng cưa.
entries.cloze_en: Grandpa cuts the tree with a saw.
